headline: DEFENDER holds the line
lede: The arcade's fourth invincible game now bleeds: Williams' 1981 planet got its score table, lives, mutation chain and an honest GAME OVER — seeded end to end.

notes.text: DEFENDER rebuilt (#1473 batch 17): the Feb port could not score, lose a life or die. Wrap-around terrain, five humans, landers that abduct (150), mutants born from landed shells (1500), mid-air catch +250, delivery +500, wave clear +1000, bonus ship every 10,000 — all on one seeded mulberry32 stream, ?seed=N replays the exact planet.

The new defendercheck (43 gates + 7 mutants) caught two real engine bugs while building: a human left frozen mid-air when its hauler lost a dive target, and a silent kill at the top of the screen (no death event, no sound). Both fixed in-engine and pinned by gates.

The #601 freeze lifted mid-morning: slot a fixed main (nightlybot roster + ws2check SAFE, #1526) and nightly run #35 went green; the seedpin floor now stands at 52 report+pin titles. Chrome's launch bug (#737) still blocks the browser tier on this box — Node gates carried the proof.
QA lane picked up a DEFENDER polish pass (#1531): thrust sound, tractor-beam telegraph, animated sprites, and the smart-bomb question.
